name: cld-flare-maxxing
description: The AI agent that runs your Cloudflare account for you: snapshot full state, generate insights/security reports, attribute changes, surface plan limits and beta features, and take guarded actions. Works with any AI coding harness.

scripts.refresh: node scripts/snapshot.mjs && node scripts/report.mjs && node scripts/betas.mjs && node scripts/build-dashboard-data.mjs && node scripts/build-actions.mjs
scripts.dashboard: npm --prefix dashboard ci && npm --prefix dashboard run dev
scripts.dashboard:build: npm --prefix dashboard ci && npm --prefix dashboard run build
